answer: Event-camera optical attestation curbs Sybil attacks in an agent economy via a telephoto sensor on a summit overlooking field nodes. The verifier broadcasts a radio nonce, and each agent flashes a signed reply on an infrared LED smaller than a walnut in one burst window. Co-located clones merge on the same pixel and are dropped, forcing attackers to space and power separate emitters beyond angular resolution. Yet fog or solar glare at dawn saturates the sensor and blocks honest nodes.
